model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of hospital admissions across five medical specialties: Cardiology, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, and Obstetrics & Pediatrics. The horizontal axis represents the hospital admissions, ranging from 0 to approximately 100, with integer tick marks spaced every 10 units. The vertical axis displays the medical specialties, listed alphabetically from left to right: Cardiology, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, and Obstetrics & Pediatrics. Each specialty is represented by a stack of bars, with the height of each bar corresponding to the approximate number of hospital admissions for that specialty. The Cardiology bar reaches a height of approximately 80 units, the Gastro bar reaches approximately 65 units, the Infect bar reaches approximately 40 units, the Neuro bar reaches approximately 30 units, and the Obstetrics & Pediatrics bar reaches approximately 20 units. The bars are not sorted, and none are visually emphasized or annotated.
